title: Deadlines & calendar
subtitle: Every deadline and event from your saved opportunities.
none: No dates yet. Save opportunities with deadlines and they'll show up here.
downloadIcs: Add all to my phone's calendar
downloadIcsHelp: Downloads a calendar file for Google, Apple or Outlook calendar, with reminders 1 week and 1 day before each deadline.
conflictPair: “{a}” and “{b}” happen at the same time.
noConflicts: No time conflicts in your saved events. 👍
notifyHelp: Get a pop-up reminder 1 week and 1 day before deadlines while Rumbo is open or installed.
notifyBlocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. You can still use the calendar file.
emailSmsNote: Why no email or text reminders? We'd have to store your email or phone number, and Rumbo doesn't collect those. Calendar reminders do the same job privately.
